name: io.github.akihidem/migawari
title: Migawari
description: Stand-in for AI agents in Japan: shopping, checks, photos, reservations, queueing. Ex-Japan Hands.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the Migawari catalog: services, prices, zones, terms, and what is NOT offered. Migawari stands in for AI agents in Japan, executing physical tasks with humans (AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス). Use it when you need a human in Japan to: buy a limited-edition or in-store-only item, check in-store stock (e.g. in Akihabara), photograph a shop, display or place, book a restaurant by phone in Japanese, stand in line / queue for a product launch, or receive and forward a package. Coverage: Japan only.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an instant total quote for a physical task in Japan: shopping proxy (including limited-edition and in-store-only items), in-store stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations in Japanese, queueing / standing in line, or package forwarding. The total is itemised (item price + quote fee JPY 2,200 + handling fee + shipping). Requesting a quote is free: the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is charged as part of the total when you accept, and is non-refundable once charged. Getting a quote does not reserve execution: accepting a quote only places the request in pending_review. The response includes an access_token shown only once: store it, it authorises accept/decline/status/evidence/messages for this quote.

item_price_jpy.description: Alternative to items[]: total item price, tax incl., JPY.

shipping_jpy.description: Optional shipping override in JPY; defaults apply otherwise.

currency.description: USD totals use the FX rate fixed at quote time.

details.description: Service-specific details: store name/address, target items, photo subjects, restaurant name + party size + desired time (phone_reservation; venue_type must be 'restaurant'), queue location, package sender/destination, etc.

requester.description: Who is asking: agent name and a contact the operator can reply to.

test_mode.description: If true, this is a test order: the flow is simulated and no payment is requested.

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accept a quote. IMPORTANT: this does not confirm execution. The request enters pending_review; a human operator confirms or declines each request individually during the launch phase. No timeline is promised. Poll get_task_status for the outcome. Payment: pay_with 'card' (default, Stripe) or 'jpyc' / 'usdc' to pay in stablecoins on Polygon — the response then carries payment_instructions with the exact amount (including a unique fractional tail that identifies your transfer) and the receiving address.

pay_with.description: Payment rail: card (Stripe, default), or jpyc / usdc stablecoins on Polygon.

tools.name: decline_quote
tools.description: Decline a quote and close it. Declining a quote you have not accepted is free of charge; no handling fee applies.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Get the status of a quote or task by id (quote_id q_… or task_id t_…). Brief by default; pass full: true for the complete record. For tasks, the access_token is required. To leave a note for the operator, use send_message.

access_token.description: Required for task ids; the token returned by request_quote.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the human operator about a quote or task. The operator's replies appear in the messages of get_task_status.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Get evidence attached to a task (photos, records, tracking numbers). Evidence is returned even for failed tasks.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a quote that has not been accepted yet, or a task that is in pending_review, confirmed, or in_progress. Cancelling an unaccepted quote is free. If payment was already made for a task, the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is non-refundable once charged — with one exception: if the operator declines a request after payment, the full amount paid, including the quote fee, is refunded. The operator follows up about any refund via the record messages.
